title: Applying Resolved Cash Back Dispute Corrections (Internal)
summary: This internal procedure explains how to apply resolved cash back dispute corrections by updating transaction rewards. It covers identifying affected transaction_id values from cash_back_disputes, unlocking the update tool (update_transaction_rewards_3847), recalculating correct rewards using card type/category/promotions (not expected_rewards), invoking the tool with transaction_id and 'X points', then verifying credit_card_transaction_history and saving audit notes.
faqs: After a cash back dispute is resolved, which transactions do I need to correct and how do I find them?
What tool do I need to unlock to update rewards for resolved disputes?
How should I recalculate the correct rewards—can I use expected_rewards from the dispute record?
What inputs does update_transaction_rewards_3847 require (transaction_id and the rewards format)?
How do I confirm the rewards update was applied successfully?
Where should I document my rewards calculation notes for auditability?
keywords: bonus category/promotion at time of purchase
